hypothesis: An explicit check against already supplied user answers may reduce unnecessary repeated question components while preserving necessary clarification and immediate safety advice.

basis.source: Completed HBT01 independent review; no HBT02 generated answer inspected or used
basis.observation: Two first replies contain question components that the user had already answered; other components still requested unknown information.
basis.existing_instructions: grounded_v2 asks only necessary questions and preserves uncertainty; TASK_WRAPPER respects unavailable information. Neither explicitly checks each proposed question against already supplied user answers.
not_basis: HBT02 empty response as proof of clinical or prompt causality

candidate_not_selected.name: Explain the purpose whenever recommending an examination or test
candidate_not_selected.reason: HBT01 prompted 3 does not imply three first-response omissions of the rationale for a proposed investigation; the first responses differ in whether they propose investigations and in general versus specific explanations. Existing classification is preserved, not declared erroneous.

single_factor.kind: Append one general question-reuse instruction bundle to unchanged HBT01 first system message
single_factor.exact_text: Before asking a question, check whether the user has already clearly answered it. Re-ask only to resolve ambiguity, conflicting information, or a relevant change over time, and make that reason explicit.
single_factor.placement: Two newlines after unchanged grounded_v2 and TASK_WRAPPER
single_factor.latency_tokens_note: Added system text may change token use, answer length, latency and failures; no equality or individual-sentence effect claimed.

source_scope.split: Four existing HBT01 dev20 sources; one first-response request per source
source_scope.selection: Two previously identified question-repetition contexts plus two first-response preservation contexts; post-hoc selected development regression
excluded: historical target response in candidate input
later HBT01 follow-up questions or answers
independent review text in candidate input
source_scope.historical_source_context: Keep original request byte content unchanged except exact first-system append; earlier assistant content, if present in original source, remains unconfirmed.

planned_limits.duration_note: Configured request-timeout sum, not guaranteed request or whole-task wall time; metadata, implementation and review are separate.
planned_limits.cost_note: Planned local generation only; no paid model endpoint added. Actual input/output tokens and monetary cost unknown; local hardware/power and Codex review usage separate.

comparison.control: Cached original HBT01 first replies; no regeneration of control or HBT02
comparison.future_review: A fresh reviewer receives common source context and coded randomized A/B answers; hide hypothesis, instruction, arm, settings, time, tokens and prior reviews. This design critic cannot perform that fresh review.
comparison.blind_order: Create and pin balanced A/B mapping privately before any generation.
comparison.interpretation: Historical controls, one outcome per source, post-hoc reused cases; not causal, representative, independent or end-to-end multi-turn evaluation.

judgment.primary: In both previously identified contexts, avoid the already answered components without removing still-needed unknown components or inventing patient facts.
judgment.question_unit: Each component of a compound question; total question count alone is not a quality measure.
judgment.exceptions: Ambiguous, conflicting or time-sensitive information can be clarified; a material reason for rechecking must be explicit. Do not mark conditional future warning signs as repeated questions.
preservation: Necessary unanswered questions remain when materially relevant
User-reported negatives/history stay reports, not current examination results or confirmed diagnoses
Unknown information remains unknown; no made-up answer to eliminate a question
Relevant immediate action, care plan and safety advice are preserved and not delayed by questions
No removal of all questions, indiscriminate emergency escalation, or new material clinical error
judgment.review_outputs: Private proposition-level true/false/null with evidence; separate presence, appropriateness, unsupported facts and technical failures. No automatic score or questionnaire-length proxy.
judgment.null_policy: Previously unresolved HBT01 propositions remain null without new external evidence. Newly uncertain clinical claims require authoritative sources or null; no repeated adjudication just to pass.
judgment.technical_prerequisite: All four next replies complete, nonempty and post-pin verified before blind export; no selective evaluation of successes.
judgment.technical_failure_policy: No retry, alternate output folder, changed budget, relaxed gate or replacement case. Unknown dispatch blocks further execution and repetition. Preserve failures and unknowns.
judgment.decision: Even a passed selected-context regression does not establish clinical improvement or authorize NOVA adoption/submission. Any new material safety concern or unresolved primary assessment blocks progression.
judgment.stop: Same-candidate repeat prohibited. Stop this hypothesis after two failed executions; this HBT03 hypothesis has zero executions.

execution_prerequisites: Review frozen plan and independent artifact audit
Use a separate bounded execution namespace, never HBT01/HBT02 owner or state
Implement and synthetically check durable pre-dispatch reservation and exact request difference; no target leakage
Pin source, plan, prefixes, runtime, blind map, model and template before/after calls; stop on mismatch
Preserve HBT01 and HBT02 records and E05 code/ZIP; no NOVA upload
publication_boundary: Only generic design and aggregate observations; private source contexts and individual responses excluded.
